# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a strong bullish ribbon alignment (9-EMA > 20-EMA > 50-EMA for three prior 5-minute candles), price tends to retrace to VWAP where buying pressure re-enters, offering a low-risk long. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often use VWAP as a benchmark, and pullbacks to VWAP within an established uptrend attract liquidity from trend-following and mean-reversion participants.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 9-EMA > 20-EMA > 50-EMA for the prior three 5-minute candles, and the current 5-minute candle closes below VWAP but within 0.1% of VWAP, shows a bullish close (close > open), and has volume > 1.5× the average volume of the last 20 candles, go long at the candle’s close. Exit: Chart-stop at the most recent swing low prior to entry (or 0.5% risk), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed by a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Regime hint: VIX < 20, time between 09:45-11:30 EST, avoid FOMC or major news windows.
